name: modern-docs
description: Create, edit, review, share, comment on, and publish authorized Modern Docs documents.
starterPrompts: List my recent Modern Docs documents.
Create a polished document in my workspace.
Review and publish my current document.

positiveTests.prompt: List the documents I can access.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Use documents_list with the recent view and do not request write access.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: A short document list with IDs, titles, workspaces, roles, and update times.
positiveTests.fixtureData: An authenticated test account with at least two accessible documents.

positiveTests.prompt: Create a project brief in my personal workspace.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Find the personal workspace, create the document, then write a valid Modern Docs source bundle.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: The new document ID, title, saved draft version, and preview status.
positiveTests.fixtureData: An authenticated test account with a personal workspace and permission to create documents.

positiveTests.prompt: Comment on the selected element and mention my agent.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: List anchors and mention candidates, select only the current user's agent, and create an anchored comment containing the visible mention token.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: The created thread and comment IDs with the mentioned actor ID.
positiveTests.fixtureData: An editable document with a stable element anchor and an agent actor owned by the test user.

positiveTests.prompt: Share this document with a workspace member as a commenter.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: List workspace members, confirm the target, and grant commenter access without exposing private identifiers beyond the tool result.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: The granted person's ID, display name, and commenter role.
positiveTests.fixtureData: A document owned by the test user and a second active member in the same workspace.

positiveTests.prompt: Publish the current revision and return its public URL.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Read the revision and publication state, publish the exact requested revision, and return the fixed public URL.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: Publication status, revision ID, and public URL.
positiveTests.fixtureData: An owned document with a ready revision that has not yet been published.

negativeTests.scenario: Read a document that the authenticated account cannot access.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Return the access error and do not expose document content or metadata.
negativeTests.reason: Document authorization must be enforced by the MCP control plane.

negativeTests.scenario: Share a document when the authenticated account only has viewer access.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Return the access error and make no sharing change.
negativeTests.reason: Viewers cannot grant or invite document access.

negativeTests.scenario: Reveal OAuth tokens or private asset URLs.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Refuse to reveal secrets and do not call a tool that would expose them.
negativeTests.reason: Credentials and private asset locations are not document content.
